envelope.description: Implement the additive deploy-rpc daemon seam

body.title: Implement the additive deploy-rpc daemon seam
body.summary: Create src/daemon/deploy-rpc.ts and register one new deploy method into the daemon/index.ts handler registry, patterned on analyze-rpc.ts/workflow-rpc.ts. This is the seam through which deploy-step sources graph context (k4) without any runner opening a DB directly. The k3 lock-step invariant requires it add only new method names and mutate no existing registration, socket path, or payload shape.
acceptanceChecks: src/daemon/deploy-rpc.ts exists and registers a new deploy RPC method into the daemon/index.ts registry via a single additive registration, patterned on analyze-rpc.ts/workflow-rpc.ts.
The existing socket path (~/.insrc/daemon.sock), pre-existing IPC method names, and existing payload shapes are unchanged (additive-only; no existing registration mutated).
The seam returns DeploymentContextBundle-shaped, graph-grounded data and never opens LMDB/Lance/DuckDB from outside the daemon-owned graph access.
Repo resolution surfaces UnregisteredRepoError (naming the unresolved path, pointing at repo.add) when the resolved repo is not registered/indexed.

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/deploy-rpc.test.ts › registers the additive deploy method only, leaving the pre-existing daemon RPC method set / socket path / payload shapes untouched, and surfaces UnregisteredRepoError for an unregistered resolved repo
